lock_semantics.binary_locked: The contracted file exists and passes exact binary/format validation.
lock_semantics.visual_production_locked: The live player-facing surface reaches the approved commercial visual bar across required viewports.

north_star: Episode 01 must read as a living construction site first and a UI second: people, work, hazards, materials and spatial change remain visible while PSI interprets the scene.
global_acceptance: construction world is the primary visual surface; no large empty black canvas
characters are grounded with equipment/material/hazard/route context
HUD interprets the scene instead of replacing it
decision UI does not cover decisive evidence
art/UI/sound/motion use one NEW PSI commercial visual system

TBM.world: changed work condition + material yard + route/access change + active crew visible
TBM.ui: PSI TRACE left + location/minimap right + change-control decision dock
TBM.decision: morning rule vs afternoon changed condition visible before explanatory copy

FIELD.world: work area + route + material/equipment context + signal visible
FIELD.ui: small signal/location/judgment controls remain secondary to world
FIELD.decision: what changed or is uncertain is readable in a few seconds

STOP_WORK.goal: physical hazard and human stop action dominate

STRATEGY.goal: site overview is the playable board
STRATEGY.world: production site overview + workers + route/risk anchors stay visible through the decision
STRATEGY.ui: compact top interpretation rows + dark glass command dock; no white modal slab over the map
STRATEGY.decision: read site -> compare people/process pressure -> act on a spatial anchor -> verify the changed field

OFFICE.goal: people and evidence share one believable room
OFFICE.world: final site office WebP remains visible: meeting table, records, whiteboard, monitor and live site outside the window
OFFICE.ui: compact transcript/evidence dock; no duplicate synthetic room or full-screen form
OFFICE.decision: hear each role -> compare statements against shared physical records -> commit responsibility basis

DAY_RESULT.goal: memory/people/record/tomorrow signal rather than detached scorecard

forbidden_drift: binary presence is not visual completion
no new placeholder art to hide layout problems
no bigger panels as a substitute for world quality
do not expand Episode 02/Field Guide backlog before Episode 01 visual lock
